This was already discussed before, but now that more people are moving to voat I think this would be a good idea. Instead of having some default subs, voat should just let new users see all the posts in /v/all and then everyone would just add all of their subverses to follow. That's great. However, are the posts you see on the front page when you are not logged in the same posts as in /r/all or is the posts of only the subs which appear on the top of the site?

I think it would be a good idea to make /v/all the default landing page, which you can change with a setting in your profile. When reddit started out there were no subreddits, just one main page, which I think is much better for smaller communities like us. Right now we're oversaturated in subverses, most of which are really just a more specific version of a broader topic. For example, do we really need a seperate /v/fallout subverse when they could just use /v/gaming and not split the already small community further? Keep in mind I'm not saying we should remove small subverses, just that they're unnecessary until we have a larger population.

As for defaults in general, I think it would be a good idea to not have them here, but only if /v/all is the default splash page. This is important because right now, when new users visit https://voat.co, they're shown the front page. Obviously this would need to change, since without defaults the front page would be empty. Sure, they could add a tutorial and direct people to /v/all, but that's terrible design, users should be shown content immediately and not be pressured into making an account.
